description: The operations this plugin consumes from Anchore's API, the input to the reducer. Every entry is a GET: the client has no write path (req-anchore-client-1). Not consumed, by ruling: secret-search, retrieved-file and file-content results, account, user, RBAC and registry endpoints, configuration and admin endpoints, export jobs and downloads, notifications and events. Edit this list only with the requirement that needs the operation.
